findings.description: Connector J906 (AT13-2P-BM04) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J906. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.

findings.description: Board (230×110mm, εr=3.9) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 330 MHz; (2,0) at 659 MHz; (0,1) at 689 MHz; (1,1) at 764 MHz; (2,1) at 954 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.

findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /SW_LHI
findings.description: Net /SW_LHI has 15 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu, In2.Cu. 9 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.

findings.description: U302 (LMQ66430MC3RXBRQ1) switching at 0.5 MHz has 117 harmonics in the 30-88 MHz band (harmonics 60-176). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U302. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.

findings.description: U302 (LMQ66430MC3RXBRQ1) switching at 0.50 MHz, duty ≈50%. Harmonic envelope: flat to 0.3 MHz, -20 dB/dec to 32 MHz, -40 dB/dec above. Harmonics extend into FCC test range starting at 60th harmonic.
findings.recommendation: Minimize the hot loop area (input cap → high-side switch → inductor → low-side switch → input cap). Every halving of loop area reduces emissions by 6 dB.

findings.description: U303 (TPS628502QDRLRQ1) switching at 0.50 MHz, duty ≈50%. Harmonic envelope: flat to 0.3 MHz, -20 dB/dec to 32 MHz, -40 dB/dec above. Harmonics extend into FCC test range starting at 60th harmonic.
